Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
📍 Location:
Austin, TX (Hybrid)
💰 Compensation:
$200,000–$230,000 Base Salary + Up to 25% Annual Bonus
About the Opportunity
A rapidly growing, multi-location organization with operations across numerous markets nationwide is seeking an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
to lead enterprise technology strategy and execution. Technology is a key driver of the company's continued growth, supporting lead generation, customer engagement, sales operations, field services, analytics, and executive decision-making.
This executive leadership position offers the opportunity to influence company-wide strategy while building and scaling a high-performing technology organization.
Position Overview
The CTO serves as the senior technology executive responsible for defining and executing the organization's technology vision, ensuring technology investments align with business objectives and support future growth.
The ideal candidate brings a blend of strategic leadership, operational excellence, and a proven ability to drive innovation, security, scalability, and digital transformation in a high-growth environment.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Strategy & Leadership
Develop and execute enterprise-wide technology strategy aligned with business goals.
Advise executive leadership on cybersecurity, AI, cloud platforms, infrastructure, enterprise applications, and emerging technologies.
Create technology roadmaps that support growth, efficiency, scalability, and security.
Evaluate technology investments based on business value, risk, and long-term sustainability.
Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices.

Technology Operations
Oversee infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity, networking, enterprise systems, and end-user technologies.
Ensure technology services remain secure, reliable, scalable, and operationally efficient.
Drive continuous improvement through performance metrics and operational excellence initiatives.

Enterprise Applications & Digital Transformation
Lead strategy for CRM, ERP, contact center technologies, collaboration platforms, and core business applications.
Reduce technical debt while enhancing platform performance, reliability, and user experience.
Partner with business leaders to optimize workflows and operational effectiveness.

Data, AI & Innovation
Develop strategies for data governance, analytics, AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
Build decision-support capabilities that improve business outcomes.
Identify innovative solutions that create measurable business value.

Cybersecurity & Business Continuity
Lead cybersecurity strategy, risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Strengthen organizational resilience and security awareness.
Protect critical systems, customer information, and business operations.

Financial & Vendor Management
Manage technology budgets, investment planning, and resource allocation.
Oversee strategic vendor partnerships and service delivery performance.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions to maximize ROI.

Team Leadership & Development
Recruit, mentor, and retain exceptional technology talent.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Develop future leaders through coaching, mentorship, and career development.

Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (Master's preferred).
Extensive experience leading enterprise technology organizations through growth and transformation.
Proven success developing technology strategy and managing large-scale technology operations.
Experience overseeing cybersecurity, cloud platforms, infrastructure, enterprise applications, data initiatives, and customer-facing technologies.
Strong financial, operational, and organizational leadership capabilities.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred
Experience supporting geographically distributed service, retail, construction, consumer services, or field-based organizations.
Experience supporting high-volume sales and contact center environments.
Track record of leading digital transformation and modernization initiatives.
Experience implementing AI and automation solutions with measurable business impact.
Expertise with enterprise CRM, contact center, cloud, collaboration, and business application platforms.

Executive-level visibility and influence.
Opportunity to shape enterprise technology strategy for a rapidly growing organization.
Lead large-scale digital transformation, AI, cybersecurity, and modernization initiatives.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Strategy & Execution (IT Project Management Office)
jobs.description:
What IT Program & Project Management Office (PMO) contributes to Cardinal Health

The PMO drives business outcomes by transforming strategic vision into execution through robust program governance, modern tools, and proactive change leadership. This function mobilizes high-performing project teams, aligns resource capacity to strategic priorities, and establishes clear accountability for deliverables. As financial and operational stewards, this job family optimizes project investments, proactively mitigates risks, and ensures rigorous adherence to quality standards while leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to ensure project success is achieved and outcomes are realized.

The Director, Technology Strategy & Execution (IT PMO) is a key leader in the IT Project Management Office responsible for shaping the portfolio and maximizing its strategic value. This role goes beyond traditional execution metrics; while maintaining a rigorous focus on delivering projects on time, within scope, and on budget, this leader ensures that the fundamental business case is met, strategic outcomes are achieved, and long-term business value is realized. This leader will oversee a portfolio of complex IT initiatives, ensuring close alignment with organizational goals, and will be instrumental in evolving the PMO into a high-performing strategic partner that actively shapes and protects business investments.

Location
- Nationwide, fully remote (with preference towards candidates in ET/CT, willing and able to travel to our global HQ in Central Ohio 5-10%)

Responsibilities

Portfolio & Strategic Alignment: Champion the IT PMO strategy by shifting from administrative progress reporting to actively shaping the enterprise portfolio, ensuring investments directly drive strategic business value and outcomes.
Predictive PMO Enablement: Champion the adoption of Planview and the integration of AI-driven insights, focusing on what will happen to drive proactive decision-making rather than merely reporting on what has already occurred.
Talent Leadership & Workforce Coaching: Build a future-ready workforce by upskilling, mentoring, and coaching project managers; cultivate critical situational skills including critical thinking, relationship building, and thriving in ambiguity.
Upstream Demand Shaping (“Shift Left”): Drive proactive “shift left” processes, including pre-project estimating and business-case planning, to ensure new work is rigorously scoped and aligned to strategic goals before execution begins.
Empowered Truth & Accountability: Foster a high-trust culture where PMO professionals are empowered to drive accountability, speak the truth on project health, and proactively escalate risks and critical dependencies.
Executive Risk & Resource Stewardship: Partner with senior leadership to assess enterprise-wide project risks, strategic dependencies, and resource constraints, facilitating timely, data-driven decisions and governance.
Vendor Accountability & Value Management: Collaborate with Solution Owners and Indirect Procurement to actively manage technology investments, leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to maximize delivered value.
Strategic Influence & Negotiation: Drive consensus and alignment across diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups in sensitive or complex business situations while maintaining positive, collaborative relationships.

Qualifications

Ideally targeting individuals with 10-12+ years of experience in IT project/program management (5+ in people leadership capacity highly preferred)
Proven experience managing large-scale IT programs, with a demonstrated ability to evolve a PMO from an execution-focused to a value-driven organization.
Prior experience with Planview is preferred, not required.
Proven experience designing and implementing front-end governance or “shift left” processes, including pre-project sizing, demand shaping, and strategic capacity management.
Exceptional relationship-building and situational leadership skills, with a proven ability to challenge status-quo thinking, negotiate high-risk vendor parameters, and influence executive stakeholders.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience in championing talent development, coaching, and building a high-performing, resilient team.
PMP or similar certification preferred.

$118,200 - $199,980 USD

jobs.title: Growth Platforms - Deloitte Microsoft Technology Practice - Global Sale & Solution Center - Architect, Senior Manager - C_MAT
jobs.description:
The Team

Deloitte delivers Microsoft services globally across strategy, architecture, implementation, and operations. Our global network offers a flexible delivery model enabling us to best serve our clients, markets, geographies with integrated solutions and services. We are recognized as a global leader in Cloud and Digital transformation. IMPORTANT NOTE: Microsoft is a Deloitte audit client, so we cannot and do not have an alliance or partnership with Microsoft.

Deloitte is recognized as an undisputed global leader in a high-growth and rapidly transforming market. We architect strategies for growth transformation and value creation. We use digital innovation to unlock business value through the power of technology. Given Deloitte's attest relationship with Microsoft it is also a priority objective to understand and promote our need for independence globally.

The Role

The Deloitte Microsoft Technology Practice is seeking a Microsoft Global Sales and Solution Center (GSSC) Architect to support strategic client opportunities. This full-time role works within a rotational, cross-functional team of architects and enablement professionals from Global Member Firms and the USI shared services team. The architect should bring deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge across Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Security, and Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI capabilities. The role requires experience in enterprise architecture, solution shaping, estimation, commercial modeling, and delivery leadership. Experience working with Deloitte practices is preferred. The GSSC coordinates across business, industry, and technology teams to accelerate offering development and provide a central hub for pursuit architecture, estimation, responsible AI, security, and delivery planning for strategic Microsoft pursuits in the U.S., including Government & Public Services.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/16/2026.

Work You'll Do

Strategic Responsibilities

Contribute to the vision, operating model, and roadmap for Microsoft GSSC initiatives in partnership with practice leadership and the Microsoft CTO/Chief Architect community.
Lead architecture and commercial shaping for complex Microsoft pursuits spanning Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Security, and Copilot and agentic AI solutions.
Translate business and industry outcomes into secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized reference architectures w/ Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected Framework.
Shape responsible AI and agentic solutions, including model and agent selection, grounding and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, observability, human oversight, and content-safety controls.
Establish trusted client relationships and guide pursuit teams through architecture tradeoffs, implementation options, delivery risk, licensing considerations, and measurable business value.
Identify reusable assets, accelerators, industry patterns, and investment priorities that differentiate Deloitte in the market.
Architect Operate and managed-service capabilities, including observability, reliability engineering, SecOps, FinOps, data governance, and continuous optimization.
Promote platform engineering, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, inner-source practices, GitHub and Azure DevOps automation, and AI-assisted software delivery.
Champion Microsoft independence requirements and permissible-use guidance in internal and client-facing activities.
Build practice capability through architecture reviews, communities of practice, webinars, coaching, and industry-specific solution enablement.

Tactical Responsibilities

Standardize pursuit intake, architecture decisions, estimation, staffing, pricing, delivery planning, and quality reviews through reusable templates and Deloitte artifact standards.
Apply Microsoft independence guidance and coordinate timely reviews for proposed technologies, solution components, demonstrations, and client interactions.
Develop estimates, consumption assumptions, licensing inputs, pricing models, and commercial constructs for cloud, data, AI, application, security, and managed-service engagements.
Coordinate with adjacent ecosystems and practices, including SAP, Oracle, data and analytics, cyber, engineering, industry, and cloud operations, for integrated solutions.
Use Azure DevOps and GitHub for demand tracking, repositories, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, architecture records, code scanning, automated testing, and AI-assisted delivery workflows.
Lead rapid prototypes and R&D for Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI services, and modern application platforms.
Embed Zero Trust, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Defender, Sentinel, data residency, accessibility, privacy, and responsible AI requirements into solution designs.
Facilitate architecture reviews and Well-Architected assessments that address reliability, security, cost optimization, operational excellence, performance efficiency, and sustainability.
Measure and continuously improve GSSC outcomes, including pursuit cycle time, estimate quality, asset reuse, architecture risk, delivery readiness, and realized business value.

Required Qualifications

Experienced Consultant 8+ years.
Five or more years of Microsoft cloud architecture, engineering, or delivery experience, including deep Azure expertise.
Demonstrated architecture experience across cloud-native applications, integration, data platforms, identity, networking, security, resiliency, and hybrid or multicloud environments.
Hands-on knowledge of generative and agentic AI patterns using Microsoft Foundry and/or Copilot Studio, including grounding, tools and connectors, orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI controls.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Power BI.
Experience with GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform, automated testing, software supply-chain security, and platform engineering.
Knowledge of Microsoft Entra, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, Zero Trust, privacy, data governance, regulatory requirements, and secure AI design.
Ability to apply the Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, architecture decision records, FinOps practices, and workload assessment methods.
Strong pursuit leadership, estimation, licensing and consumption planning, commercial shaping, executive communication, and cross-functional team-management skills.
Experience developing reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, or industry solutions is preferred.
Deloitte experience and practical knowledge of Microsoft independence requirements are preferred.
Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification is preferred; Azure AI Engineer Associate, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, or equivalent role-relevant credentials are beneficial.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200-$278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
